name: Unending Torment

angles.text: Master Apothecary Faranell leads the Royal Apothecary Society in the Undercity. For the Forsaken, punishing enemies of the Dark Lady like Garithos is central to their retribution.
By helping Faranell in the Undercity, you take part in the severe methods the Forsaken use against those who have crossed them and the Banshee Queen.

faq.answer: Othmar is Grand Marshal Othmar Garithos, the former human commander who made an uneasy alliance with Sylvanas Windrunner during Lordaeron’s reclamation. The Forsaken betrayed and killed him. Master Apothecary Faranell now holds his remains for continued torment and experiments.

Othmar Garithos aided Sylvanas Windrunner in taking Capital City back from the dreadlords. Yet he despised non-humans and sought to claim all Lordaeron for humanity. The Forsaken hold him guilty of crimes against the Dark Lady and judge chemical torment fitting for his arrogance and deeds.
Master Apothecary Faranell heads the Royal Apothecary Society in the Undercity’s Apothecarium. He oversees the making of serums, toxins, and plagues, and directs the operation against Othmar.
Hissing Serum is an alchemical brew by Master Apothecary Faranell. It simmers flesh and brings excruciating pain as it flows from an apparatus above Othmar’s suspended body.
faq.q: What does the Hissing Serum do?

faq.answer: Othmar is undead. The Dark Lady slew Garithos herself, and his head has been joined to an abomination’s body that twitches to life. Faranell calls him their “new guest” and intends to keep him suffering beneath the dripping serum.

Master Apothecary Faranell plans to keep Othmar’s flesh simmering beneath the dripping apparatus and watch him closely. He says he has extensive plans for Othmar’s future, with further experiments and retribution in store.
faq.q: What does Faranell plan to do with Othmar next?

sections.body: In the Undercity’s Apothecarium, Master Apothecary Faranell conducts harsh experiments against the Forsaken’s enemies. He has prepared Hissing Serum, a caustic substance meant to drip without end onto a captive beneath an alchemical apparatus.
sections.title: Apothecary Retribution

sections.body: Grand Marshal Garithos lies beneath Faranell’s apparatus as Othmar, his remains held in a suspended framework. Faranell judges chemical torment fitting for crimes against the Dark Lady. The serum runs down over Othmar’s body, simmering his flesh as punishment and study.
sections.title: The Fate of Garithos

summary: Master Apothecary Faranell sets a punishment in motion beneath the Undercity. In the Apothecarium, the Royal Apothecary Society turns Hissing Serum against Othmar’s remains, seeking lasting retribution for crimes against the Dark Lady.
